summary: Warns that protocols such as ARP and Neighbor Discovery carry link-layer addresses whose bit order differs between LAN technologies. Implementors must take care to use the canonical form so that all parties interpret the bits the same way. It is informational.

eli5.summary: Some places write dates month first and others write the day first, so a date can be misread. Some networks write address bits in a different order in the same way.

questions: why are mac address bit orders different
